about: Machine-readable catalogue of the Elephants components. build.py asserts that every class exists in components.css and every token exists in tokens.css. 'core' = reviewed and accepted in Round 05; 'candidate' = introduced by the example screens, usable but must be confirmed by the first page that needs it (see .claude/skills/elephants-design/references/build-page.md).

components.name: Button
components.use: Runs an action on the current screen. To go to another page use a link.
a11y: Native <button>; min height 44 px
Icon-only buttons need aria-label
Visible focus ring from --el-color-focus

components.name: Alert
components.use: Tells something about the interface or the information: what happened and what the person can do. Never rates a territory or contract.
a11y: Colour lives in the icon and border; text stays in --el-color-text
Dynamic alerts use role=status (info) or role=alert (error)

components.name: Field
components.use: Collects a value to filter or search. Always with a visible label.
a11y: <label for>
Error: aria-invalid=true + aria-describedby pointing to the message
Error text says how to fix it

components.name: Risk tag
components.use: Names the risk category of a territory, entity or contract. The category comes from the methodology (TASK-07), never chosen by hand.
variants: large (once, at the top of a detail page)
a11y: Text label always present; 1/2/3-bar glyph encodes level without colour
Unknown is hatched/dashed, never a lighter 'low'

components.name: Counter
components.use: A large number with its name below; summarises a query in one scannable row.
a11y: Number and label in the same element so they are read together

components.name: Active filter
components.use: Shows an applied filter and removes it in one tap.
a11y: <button> with aria-label 'Quitar filtro: <value>'

components.name: Key figure
components.use: A big number that stands on its own, even in a shared screenshot: what it measures, out of how many, and where it comes from.
a11y: Unit and denominator in text, not only visual
Source line always present

components.name: Data table
components.use: To compare and verify; the accessible alternative to every map or chart.
a11y: <caption>, <th scope>
Wrap in an element with overflow-x:auto on small screens

components.name: Map with legend
components.use: Colours each territory by the share of contracts with signals. The legend says what colour measures; selection is an outline plus a detail panel.
a11y: <svg role=img> with <title>
A data table with the same values is always reachable
Selection never by colour alone

components.name: Status pill
components.use: Neutral process state of a contract (e.g. 'En ejecución'). Not a risk level.
a11y: Text label; icon is decorative

components.name: Coverage bar
components.use: Shows flagged / analysed without signals / not analysed out of the total, so missing data is visible.
a11y: Legend with numbers in text next to the bar

components.name: Breakdown bars
components.use: Ranks a few counts (e.g. signals by type) inside a panel.
a11y: Values written as text; bars are decorative

components.name: Progress vs expected
components.use: Paid or executed share against the expected mark. The red mark is kept as an alert cue (decided Round 05 review).
a11y: Both percentages written as text

components.name: Signal item
components.use: One numbered signal with a short title and the fact behind it. A signal, not a verdict.
a11y: Use an ordered list; the number is not colour-only
